title: Dataloaders
purpose: Provide reusable loaders for every admitted data form.
boundary: This Hero owns source loading. Encoder Heroes own representation models. Hx14 owns observation and evidence contracts. A loader does not score an encoder or admit an experiment.
summary: Numeric series is the first loader. It is the memory-mapped kline loader, kept in its own tree. Other data forms are not recorded yet.

goals.title: Numeric series loader
goals.description: Time series is the first admitted form. The loader is the torch memory-mapped kline loader, isolated from encoders and from the observation archive.

milestones.title: Keep the numeric-series loader in its own tree
milestones.description: The loader, its headers, one translation unit and its storage tests live under code/dataloaders/numeric_series and build without an encoder.
acceptance: The numeric-series tree contains the imported loader headers, record_types.cpp and the two storage tests.
The tree builds and its storage tests pass from its own makefile, with products under /opt/mityane-geometrics/dataloaders/build/numeric-series.

milestones.title: Add the retrieval channel table beside the loader
milestones.description: read_loader_settings fills channel_form_t and source_form_t from SOURCE_DEFAULTS, KLINE_SOURCE_SET, and CHANNEL_SET. A checked-in table that states the live channels is not in this tree yet. Writing that table does not select a training population or start an encoder run.
acceptance: A configuration beside the numeric-series loader states each channel's interval, activity, record type, input length, future length, channel weight and normalization policy.
The configuration does not select a training population or start an encoder run.

evidence.label: Reader for the three settings blocks, and the note that no table is checked in
